amp.heartbeat_estimator: nearest cadence, half-interval tolerance; unique timestamps between first and last heartbeat only
amp.coverage_limit: Fixed-window sampling completeness, not uptime or TTL liveness. Cadence jitter across slot boundaries can create adjacent-slot misses. Internal first/last coverage is secondary. No platform ingestion, signature verification, 24-hour operation or Monitor evidence is inferred.
amp.task_roundtrip: Use coordinator per-task elapsed_ms; AMP access includes send or handler duration only.
amp.evidence_level: local AMP files; platform ingestion and continuous operation require separate evidence
amp.heartbeat_sampling_estimator: [start,end); slots anchored at window start; floor((timestamp-start)/interval); one hit per slot; final partial slot counts once

scheduler.interpretation: Observed in-window events only; reported completed is not independent business recovery. Missing endpoints and conflicts remain unknown; no expected schedule denominator is inferred.

coordinator.interpretation: Tasks are selected by started_at in [start,end); final snapshot outcomes may finish beyond the window. elapsed_ms is coordinator-measured task elapsed, including approval waiting when present, transport and validation; not pure network RTT, fault-to-recovery time or AMP duration. Failed task measurements are retained.

latency_metrics.metric: Coordinator task elapsed (approval may be included)

limitations: Recorded fixed window; neither uptime nor 24-hour/7-day acceptance is inferred.
Missing inputs, endpoints and durations remain unknown; zero events does not prove a disabled or healthy service.
No Kafka/Monitor ingestion, certificate/signature validation, scheduled-cycle completeness or physical-effect proof is inferred.
AMP send/handler duration and coordinator task elapsed are distinct measurements; AMP sample counts are unavailable in the unchanged legacy summary.
